# Northgate Research Employee Handbook

Welcome to Northgate Research. This handbook explains how we work together, what we expect from each other, and where to find help when something is unclear.

## Working Hours

Core hours run from 10:00 to 15:00 in each office's local time zone. Outside core hours, teams agree on their own schedules with their **team lead**.

### Remote Work

Remote work is allowed for up to *three* days per week. Requests for a fully remote arrangement go through the [people team](https://people.northgate-research.test/requests).

- Book a desk before coming to the office.
- Keep your calendar up to date.
  - Mark focus time explicitly.
  - Decline meetings without an agenda.
- Log time off in the HR portal.

## Equipment

| Item | Standard | Refresh cycle |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Laptop | 14-inch, 32 GB RAM | 3 years |
| Monitor | 27-inch, 4K | 5 years |
| Headset | Noise cancelling | 2 years |

### Requesting Equipment

Open a ticket with the tag `equipment` and include your cost centre.

```bash
ngctl ticket create --tag equipment --cost-centre 4410
```

## Security

1. Use the password manager for every account.
2. Report lost devices within one hour to the [security desk](mailto:security@northgate-research.test).
3. Never forward internal documents to personal mailboxes.

## Questions

If anything in this handbook is unclear, ask in the people channel or write to people@northgate-research.test.

REFUND POLICY

Northgate Research issues refunds for research subscriptions cancelled within fourteen days of the first invoice. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within ten working days.

Subscriptions cancelled after fourteen days remain active until the end of the paid period and are not refunded. Enterprise agreements follow the terms of their own contract.

To request a refund, send the invoice number and the account owner's name to the billing desk. We answer every request within two working days.

- Invoice number
- Account owner
- Reason for cancellation

Billing Desk

billing@northgate-research.test
 
Exceptions

Refunds are not available for one-off report purchases once the report has been downloaded. Partial refunds for unused seats are calculated per calendar day.

Questions about this policy can be sent to the billing desk at any time; we review the policy every January.

Field Kit 4.2

Field Kit 4.2 ships the offline synchronisation engine that teams asked for during the spring review. It replaces the polling client and reduces battery use by 38 percent on the reference tablet.

What's new

  • Offline forms queue locally and sync when a connection returns.
  • Photo attachments are compressed before upload.
  • The site map now supports custom layers from the layer catalogue.

Compatibility

Android12Supported
iPadOS16Supported
Windows11Preview

Upgrade steps

Run the migration before installing the new client:

ngctl fieldkit migrate --to 4.2
ngctl fieldkit verify

Report problems through the support portal.

Harbour Street Site Visit

The team visited the Harbour Street building on the morning of 8 September to confirm the sensor layout for the autumn deployment. The landlord walked us through the ground floor and the two upper floors, pointing out the areas where the roof works are still in progress.

The ground floor is ready for installation. Power is available in every room, and the network cabinet has space for the gateway. The first floor needs two additional sockets in the east corridor before the sensors can be mounted.

The second floor cannot be surveyed until the roof works finish at the end of September. We agreed to return in the first week of October and to keep the original device count of forty-two sensors.
